svg.title: One runtime. An agent for every user.
svg.desc: Multi-cloud, multi-tenant architecture. Authenticated users share the AgentForEach runtime, while memories, sessions, schedules, files, sandboxes and connections remain scoped to each user. Six platform contracts map to your choice of Azure, Cloudflare or AWS. AWS is in preview. Model providers are configured independently of the cloud.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
